name: Band Glute Kickback
steps: Loop a low-anchored band around one ankle, face the anchor, and hinge slightly forward using a wall or chair for balance.
Brace your core and keep your standing knee slightly soft with your pelvis square.
Drive your banded leg smoothly backward by squeezing your glute until your hip reaches full extension.
Bring your foot slowly back beneath you under tension, then switch legs after finishing one side.
tips: Stop extending your leg before your lower back begins to arch.
Keep your hips square to the anchor rather than opening your working hip outward.
